text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since there was a little time before 
training started, I was watching a TV show 
called "National Ekiben Special" with 
Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“――Well, we had an endless lineup of 
delicious-looking ekiben today too! See 
you all next week!”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...No, Trainer! Before that, I'd like you 
to reconsider the menu!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"What we need right here is a single 
spotlight! Complete and total focus on 
just one menu item!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Remember them. The ekiben featured on the 
show... Their majestic brilliance, brought 
together under a single, intensely shining 
main dish!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Just like a great charismatic 
figure who drives the crowd into a frenzy 
and turns them into a massive tide!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The potential gained from brilliantly 
polishing a single individuality... It is 
truly infinite!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
From koji-grilled brand pork to 
whole-grilled seafood... depending on the 
local specialties, bento boxes can 
showcase an ever-changing, radiant 
variety.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And eventually, when those distinct traits 
have grown worthy of taking center stage, 
I will be the vessel that weaves them into 
a dazzling harmony...! Mmm, what a 
thrilling plan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you want to focus on one 
training menu right now. With the goal of 
ultimately attaining an all-around, 
flawless strength... That seems to be the 
idea.
choice_data_list: I see, you have a point...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well then, let's start! 
Possibilities are infinite, and time is 
limited!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her bento analogy caught me off guard, but 
her plan made sense. Considering her 
motivation, I decided to go with the menu 
she requested.
